t: Tickets & Fares - Capitol Corridor
s: August 18, 2016 - Tickets purchased online, from a station ticket agent or at a self-service Ticket Kiosk machine, are issued as electronic tickets, or eTickets. If you book your ticket online, you will receive an email receipt with your eTicket attached as a PDF that can then be printed out or pulled up on your mobile device. You can also buy your ticket and access it from the Amtrak mobile app.
